scope: New 6 mm handle, wire routing, and assembly access. Head identity and original 0–20 degree reference range checked separately; no full-stroke head clearance claim.
headCalibrationNote: Builder measured 6 mm on the printed v2 head. The old ideal 7 mm crank model shows small body overlaps beyond its original range and does not establish the as-built jaw angle. Keep the assembled head, fit the wire to its real closed position, and check for rubbing without forcing it.
limitations: Prototype: dimensional collision checks, not force, buckling, wear, or friction tests. Printed guide fit and wire grip require a bench test. Tube ID is much larger than the wire; internal bowing remains possible.
